purpose: Prospective batch02 registration/display criteria, set before viewing batch02 raw/native products; detector and selection immutable.

grid.usable: Best median correlation >0.8; >=18 valid regions in >=5 orders; median absolute continuum peak offset <=1 pixel.

local.usable: Both sides have sufficient samples and interpolated continuum peak within 1 pixel of predicted center.

interpretation: These conservative heuristic flags control raw mapping usability only, not an automatic astrophysical origin veto. Low-correlation or displaced cases remain explicit. Mapping module derived from post-hoc batch01 troubleshooting; not blind independent validation.
